reason: The text does not state or imply that priest leaders are superior to non-priest leaders. While the passage identifies Aaron as a Levite and assigns him a prophetic role alongside Moses, it presents them as co-leaders with distinct but complementary functions under God's command. The text contains no comparative claim about the superiority of priests over non-priests. Both Moses (a non-priest) and Aaron (a Levite) are commissioned equally to lead the Israelites out of Egypt, with no suggestion of hierarchical superiority.
